name: nulang
description: Nulang is an actor-based runtime and programming language that's type-safe, compiled, and designed for building fast, distributed, resilient applications.

paragraphs: A typed language for concurrent, durable, and distributed software with algebraic effects, reference capabilities, actors, and durable execution.
New to Nulang? Try Core in the browser (no install) · Install a checksummed release · Run the quick start. Native actors, networking, and durable runtime features require a local binary.

Nulang is a programming language for concurrent, durable, and distributed software. Its semantic core combines a Hindley-Milner type system, reference capabilities (iso/trn/ref/val/box/tag/lineariso), and row-polymorphic algebraic effects. Erlang-style fault-tolerant actors are the first-class abstraction for independently addressable isolated state; ordinary local computation remains ordinary computation rather than being modeled as an actor. features: Algebraic effects — perform Effect.op(args) / handle body with { | Effect.op(x) => ... } with resume semantics. Effect dependencies are explicit in function signatures via ! rows.
Reference-capability types — iso, trn, ref, val, box, tag, and lineariso govern aliasing, mutation, ownership, and cross-actor sendability. They are distinct from external authority grants.
Hindley-Milner type inference — full Algorithm W with row-polymorphic records, variant types, and algebraic effect rows.
Actors — spawn, send/!, ask, selective receive with after timeout, links, monitors, supervision trees, process groups, and actor priority scheduling.
